newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to issue rules creating new pension funds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to issue rules creating new pension funds.

text.p: Rules allowing insurance firms to create pension funds for professionals and small firms, similar to the 401K funds in the United States, will be ready by December, said Brazil's insurance watchdog Susep.
"This is the last knot that has to be untied to allow the full development of the country's promising pension market," Susep's superintendant Helio Portocarrero said in a telephone interview.
Under the rules, insurance companies will be allowed to create the new funds starting in January, he said.
He said the project would then be sent to the Finance Ministry which will revise it and send it to Congress for a vote.
"We expect to have the new regulation for the reinsurance market by the end of the first half of 1997," Portocarrero said.
Rules outlining the private sector's entry into the country's reinsurance market have been long-awaited by foreign reinsurers aiming to invest in Brazil.
